title: Practice 10: How a prefix changes a verb of motion

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **уходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of уходить: imperfective (perfective partner: уйти).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
**уходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of уходить: imperfective (perfective partner: уйти).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**уходишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of уходить: imperfective (perfective partner: уйти).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.prompt: At what time are you leaving?

exercises.why: **войдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**уйдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
**входило** — past tense (neuter) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: It wasn't part of the plan.

exercises.why: **выходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of выходить: imperfective (perfective partner: выйти).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: My house faces to the south.

exercises.why: **входит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: Is it included in the price?
